value:
A relocation screen that compares SYMBOL NAMES is structurally blind to every row where one side's symbol is a compiler-private anonymous pool entry, and it reports that blindness as the number 0. Measured at 84f85a96a: `python tools/gdl/composed_census/wf_word_diff.py game/enemy/enemy.c move_logic00` printed `RELOC-SYMBOL MISMATCH = 0` while +0x1e4 relocates lbl_80346840 (400921fb54524550 = pi) in the target and @689 (401921fb54524550 = 2*pi) in ours -- the datum transposition attempt.WV_movelogic00-re-served-as-permute-plus-recolor-because-the-retracted-rules-defect-was-a-datum-transposition-no-recolor-can-reach.20260904.v1 had to find with wf_ordered_datum_screen.py. The cause is one `continue` in `reloc_symbol_mismatches`: when `resolve_reloc_symbol_positional` returns None for either side the row is dropped, and 2,741 rows in 625 of the 2,841 reloc-comparable functions take that path image-wide.

THE ROWS ARE DECIDABLE BY VALUE, with fndiff's own readers (`target_datum_bytes`, `ours_datum_bytes`, `_datum_prefix_equal`) and no new comparison layer. By value the 2,741 split 2,561 VALUE-EQUAL / 145 VALUE-DIFFERS / 35 undecidable.

THREE EXCLUSION CLASSES ARE MANDATORY, each measured by READING the 145 rather than counting them: (1) JUMPTABLE, 122 rows -- the payload is linked branch addresses and ours are zeros until link, so byte-exact functions inside the 100%-matched zlib and MSL regions flag (zlib/inflate::inflate, MSL/printf::parse_format); (2) OUR DATUM ALL-ZERO at equal length, 13 rows -- an unlinked address table whose content is the linker's (MSL/printf::longlong2str 132B, dolphin/dvd::stateReady 32B, mb_font::MBRenderText 84B); (3) TARGET-SIDE ANONYMOUS NAME, 2 rows -- `@N` IS NOT GLOBALLY UNIQUE: `@40` is defined TWICE in config/GUNE5D/symbols.txt (.rodata 0x80117848 size 0x1A and .sdata 0x803440AC size 0x4), so a name->address map answers with whichever came last, which made TRK_MINNOW_DOLPHIN/Portable/nubinit::TRKNubWelcome -- `fndiff --clean` MATCH, 0 real diff lines -- read as "OFF" versus "MetroTRK".

Ten rows in six functions survive: move_logic00 (pi vs 2*pi), ui/options::show_optmenu ("Accept" vs "Select"), world/camera::camera_mode_follow (0.7 and 0.25 against one shared 4330000000000000), game/player::write_health_and_items, anim/action::DoPlayerAction, and pb_diag::pbDiagDrawInfo (NOT-DECIDABLE: target `whichatree`, ours `lbl_8023D180`). A surviving row is EVIDENCE TO READ, not a verdict -- the screen that DECIDES a pool-order residual remains wf_ordered_datum_screen.py, which pairs ordered datum sequences instead of offsets.
